notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port / east-midlands.

Sheffield Supertram: SYFTL (South Yorkshire Future Tram Limited) took over from Stagecoach on 22 Mar 2024. No public GTFS or GTFS-RT feed has been confirmed under SYFTL — this is a genuine operator-transition skip risk, distinct in kind from the National Rail account block. fetchSupertramStopBoard() in lib/providers/south-yorkshire.js throws SupertramFeedUnconfirmedError rather than fabricating a schedule. See docs/south-yorkshire-d1/hazard-pack.md H2.

Only the printed termini + named via-points + hub given by the oracle report's line descriptions (report line 39) are catalogued below — NOT a full ordered 51-stop list. See docs/south-yorkshire-d1/published-network.json coverageGaps.

Purple line's Gleadless Townend branch junction point is not given by the report — Gleadless Townend is catalogued as a stop (shared with Blue) but no direction chip is generated for it on the Purple line (see marketing-directions.js); do not guess the junction.

Supertram lat/lng superseded 7 Sep 2026 (uk-catalog-geocode) — no GTFS feed exists (unchanged, see H2), but NaPTAN carries confirmed stop-level coordinates (StopType TMU, ATCO prefix 3700ZZSY). Most stops match a direct NaPTAN stem after stripping directional "Platform to <destination>" suffixes; Sheffield Station and Sheffield Arena needed an explicit name mapping to NaPTAN's own combined-stop labels ("Sheffield Stn/Hallam Uni", "Arena/Olympic Legacy Park") — see the Coordinates note below.

Sheffield Station (SHF) is the hub lock — Supertram tram viaduct above National Rail main platforms, footbridge connects. doNotGroup: separate catalog entries by mode (train vs metro), same printed name, same pattern as East Midlands' Nottingham Station.

Meadowhall Interchange (MHS, National Rail entry) / Meadowhall (Supertram Yellow terminus + Tram-Train through-running point) is a through-running/infrastructure-switch point, NOT a second hub lock — Tram-Train switches onto National Rail infrastructure here. Modelled as two mode-tagged catalog entries (aliased to each other's printed name), same doNotGroup-by-mode pattern as Sheffield Station.

Rotherham Central appears both as a Supertram Tram-Train through-running stop (metro entry) and a National Rail through-running-only station (train entry, crs RMC, live-verified 5 Sep 2026 — the oracle report gave no code). No shared platform with National Rail main-line trains per the report.

Darton (DRT), South Elmsall (SES), Moorthorpe (MRP) are National Rail-only West Yorkshire/South Yorkshire boundary stations; CRS codes live-verified 5 Sep 2026 (the oracle report gave no codes). May appear in a future West Yorkshire region's feed too — D2 de-dup boundary, not resolved here. Denby Dale is ruled West Yorkshire's home station per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md (5 Sep 2026) and is no longer catalogued here.
Chesterfield is deliberately NOT in this catalog — it is East Midlands' station (docs/east-midlands-d1/published-network.json throughRunningOnly, crs CHD). See notInRegion below.
